svg.title: Solai · Greyscale high-rise balcony study
svg.desc: Editable vector concept: an open planted balcony in a compact vertical neighborhood looks across a lake to mountains and a ridge-top wind farm. A neighboring residential tower is cropped at the left edge, with individual stacked terraces and planting. The original sky, sun, mountains, water and reflections are retained unchanged. Named groups separate the wind turbines, tower, balcony floor, transparent railing and individual plants. Pure grayscale; no images, fonts, filters, external resources or symbol instances.
